Communication and Collaboration

How do I collaborate effectively online?

Short Answer

Agree on roles, shared documents and ways of working. Keep contributions accessible, respectful and easy for the team to find.

Detailed Guidance

Agree how the team will communicate, make decisions, manage shared documents and track actions. Use accessible formats, clear file names and inclusive meeting practices, and record important decisions where the whole team can find them.
